==Notes ==
*Historically, Mountain Trolls have been commonly [[farming|farmed]] for gold, although other farms have taken over in popularity since the release of [[Eye of the North]].  Their only drops, [[Mountain Troll Tusks]], are worth 8 gold each, and weapons traded for 5 of them can be sold for 125 gold.

==Trivia==
*Oddly, they have one eye while the rest of the trolls have two.
{{anomaly|This monster uses attack skills from two different weapon attributes.}}
